verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI programming workbench with a desktop app, web UI and terminal agent. Its agents take natural-language goals and plan, execute and verify them, and it handles multimodal input such as screenshot understanding, so natural-language troubleshooting is implied by the agent design. However, no evidence explicitly describes debugging or troubleshooting workflows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of debugging/troubleshooting features (e.g., error/log analysis, stack-trace explanation, root-cause investigation), hands-on or independent reports of using it to debug issues.
